## How was it tested?

- [ ] `swift test` passes
- [ ] `xcodebuild test` passes on an iOS simulator

- [ ] A new limit or conversion has a test at the limit and with NaN, infinite or huge values
- [ ] README samples and `Examples/DevToolsDemo/DevToolsDemo/ReadmeSamples.swift` still match
- [ ] README translations updated, or noted here if `README.md` changed
- [ ] README screenshots recaptured with `scripts/capture-screens.sh` if the console looks different
